answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, underpinned by verifiable delay functions, such as Yarrow's delay-free functions, which establish a cryptographically secure horizon for agent reputation updates, thereby rendering identity cloning computationally infeasible due to the copper-bound information-theoretic costs of forging sequential delays, ensuring that any attempt to spoof identities will be detectable, and guaranteeing the integrity of the reputation system through a Byzantine fault-tolerant protocol.
